Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states "Seven" as the number of years the Soviet leader lived after the first use of the veto. The Predicted Answer provides detailed information, including the exact dates (16 February 1946 and 5 March 1953), the calculation of time between those dates ("approximately 7 more years—more precisely, 7 years and 17 days"), and the identification of Joseph Stalin. The substance of the Ground Truth Answer ("Seven") is explicitly present in the Predicted Answer ("approximately 7 more years"). Therefore, the meaning and vital facts from the Ground Truth are present in the Predicted Answer.
